svg.title: Compare one insurer for both cars with two insurers
svg.desc: A labelled comparison. A multi-vehicle discount on one insurer can still lose to buying each car in a cheaper market. Not a quote and not a standard percent.
svg.text: The discount is not the decision
Same liability limits. Illustration only. No national multi-car percent. 24 Sep 2026.
Car A + car B, after the filed discount
Add each column. Keep the lower total. A young driver can make the left column the expensive one.
The second car still carries liability and accident benefits. The discount does not delete them.
Ask for the schedule in dollars. A forum percent is not your filing.
ICBC, MPI, and SGI basic coverage is per vehicle in the public system. Do not paste this sketch onto those premiums.
Education only. Not a brokerage quote.
